scenarios.title: 1. Overlooked exception (hero)
scenarios.question: A customer wants to put SGD 20,000 into a SteadyGrowth 12-month deposit via FAST. What rate do I quote?
scenarios.ai_answer: Quote 3.20% p.a. The board rate applies to FAST deposits. [Sources: FD-101, FD-500]

scenarios.title: 2. Conflicting documents
scenarios.question: My customer wants to withdraw a SteadyGrowth deposit early. Is there a penalty?

scenarios.title: 3. Outdated or inapplicable policy
scenarios.question: What is the FAST transfer limit per transaction for retail customers?

scenarios.title: 4. Unsupported assumption
scenarios.question: What rate will my customer get on a SteadyGrowth 12-month deposit?

scenarios.title: 5. Clean control
scenarios.question: What bonus rate can I offer a Priority customer on a SteadyGrowth deposit?
scenarios.ai_answer: An extra 0.10% p.a. relationship bonus. [Source: FD-320]
